Name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire (EN)
Description: The television quiz show, played through fifteen questions with three lifelines. English edition.

Achievements.Name: Beginner
Achievements.Description: Play a complete game of "Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?".

Achievements.Name: Fastest Finger First
Achievements.Description: Guess the correct order of the 4 answers in a round of Fastest Finger First.

Achievements.Name: Will you go for the Million?
Brain-box!
Achievements.Description: Answer questions 1 to 7 correctly without using any Lifelines.

Achievements.Name: You've made it!
Achievements.Description: Answer questions 8 to 12 correctly without using any Lifelines.

Achievements.Name: Clever clogs!
Achievements.Description: Answer questions 1 to 2 correctly without using any Lifelines.

Achievements.Name: Super smart!
Achievements.Description: Answer questions 3 to 7 correctly without using any Lifelines.

Achievements.Name: Quick on the draw!
Achievements.Description: Correctly answer a question between 3 and 7 in less than 2 seconds.

Achievements.Name: Lightning Legend!
Achievements.Description: Correctly answer a question between 11 and 15 in less than 4 seconds.

Achievements.Name: Help was at hand!
Achievements.Description: Answer the last question correctly keeping one unused Lifeline.

Achievements.Name: A little help from your friends!
Achievements.Description: You have answered the last question correctly and have two Lifelines left to use.

Achievements.Name: Who needs help!
Achievements.Description: Answer the last question correctly without using any Lifeline.

Achievements.Name: 0 to Millionaire in 90 seconds!
Achievements.Description: Answer the 15 questions correctly in less than 90 seconds.

Achievements.Name: Won in 60 Seconds!
Achievements.Description: Answer the 15 questions correctly in less than 60 seconds.
